Volunteer.name: Volunteer
Volunteer.description:
🤲 You spent your weekends at the community center and in disaster drills.

🩹 You carry a first aid card in your wallet.
🧒 You know how to keep kids calm and busy.

📈 Grants: First Aid +5, Childcare +5
Volunteer.traitNarrativeEffects: The character volunteered through high school: tutoring kids, helping at the community center and disaster drills. They stay calm with frightened people, know basic first aid and are trusted by children and the elderly.
